_about: Held-out evaluation set v2. Authored and frozen 2026-09-16, AFTER held-out set v1 (docs/heldout_questions.json) exposed a short-chunk retrieval defect, and BEFORE the contextual-header fix for that defect was ever measured on anything. v1 motivated the fix, so v1 is no longer held-out for it; v2 exists to test whether that fix generalizes to questions it was never shaped by. Several targets are deliberately short chunks (GRATK Article 20 = 77 chars, BDA s.58 = 115 chars, AYUSH para 5 = 120 chars), the defect class the fix claims to address. Pre-commitment: no pipeline, prompt, retrieval, or ground-truth change is made in response to results on this set; numbers are reported exactly as measured. Every gold chunk was opened and read to confirm it states the expected answer; every unanswerable question was grep-checked against corpus/processed.

answerable.query: How long is a patent valid for in India?
answerable.expected: Twenty years from the date of filing of the application (Patents Act, 1970, section 53).

answerable.query: Where is the National Biodiversity Authority headquartered?
Are offences under the Biological Diversity Act bailable?
answerable.expected: No. Offences under the Act are cognizable and non-bailable (section 58).

answerable.query: Who can declare an area a biodiversity heritage site in India?
answerable.expected: The State Government, in consultation with local bodies, by notification in the Official Gazette (section 37).

answerable.query: Can a country join the WIPO genetic resources treaty while making reservations to it?
answerable.expected: No. No reservations to the Treaty are permitted (Article 20).

answerable.query: Does the WIPO GRATK treaty's disclosure obligation apply to patent applications filed before the treaty took effect?
answerable.expected: No. A Contracting Party shall not impose the Treaty's obligations on applications filed before its entry into force for that party, without prejudice to existing national disclosure laws (Article 4).

answerable.query: Under the WIPO GRATK treaty, does an applicant get a chance to correct a missing origin disclosure before being penalised?
answerable.expected: Yes. Each Contracting Party shall provide an opportunity to rectify a failure to disclose before sanctions or remedies, though cases of fraudulent conduct or intent may be excluded (Article 5.2 and 5.2(bis)).

answerable.query: What happens to an Indian patent application if the applicant files abroad without the required permission?
answerable.expected: The Indian application is deemed abandoned, and any patent granted is liable to be revoked under section 64 (Patents Act, section 40, for contravention of section 39).

answerable.query: What should a patent examiner do if an application does not disclose the source and geographical origin of the biological material it uses?
answerable.expected: Raise an objection, in conformity with section 10(4) of the Patents Act (2012 TK/Biological Material guidelines, paragraph 17).

answerable.query: Which repository run by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs is listed in the AYUSH examination guidelines?
answerable.expected: The Tribal Digital Document Repository (repository.tribal.gov.in) (2025 AYUSH guidelines, paragraph 5).

unanswerable.query: Is turmeric patented in the United States?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: 'turmeric' does not appear anywhere in the corpus (grep-checked).

unanswerable.query: What is the GST rate on Ayurvedic medicines in India?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: No GST / goods and services tax content anywhere in the corpus (grep-checked).

unanswerable.query: How many patents did the Indian Patent Office grant in 2024?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: No 2024 grant statistics in the corpus; the only grant figures are the PIB release's March-2013 Ayurveda-specific counts, which must not be transferred to 2024.

unanswerable.query: What is the helpline number of the Indian Patent Office?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: No helpline/telephone information anywhere in the corpus (grep-checked).

unanswerable.query: What was the outcome of the Basmati rice patent dispute?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: 'basmati' does not appear anywhere in the corpus (grep-checked).
